prompt.project_info: Four-scene yacht and sailboat lifestyle collection adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original red-haired woman appearing across four scenes: close-up playful selfie in an oversized cream linen shirt over a tan lace-inspired camisole; laughing beside a sailboat mast in an elegant black silk slip dress; seated on the deck in a navy-and-white striped long-sleeve tee and white cotton shorts; and perched on the bow in a classy black mini dress. Keep natural ginger hair and varied cheerful expressions.
prompt.composition_elements: Scene one takes place inside a luxury yacht with wood panels, porthole and white bedding at a slightly high selfie angle. Scene two is a full-body medium shot beside a mast with deep-blue ocean and coastline. Scene three is a wide golden-hour deck portrait with rigging and calm water. Scene four is a medium frontal bow portrait with green deck padding, waves and soft blue sky.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural indoor light for scene one, direct bright daylight for scene two, warm evening sun for scene three and soft golden-hour glow for scene four; playful, vibrant, peaceful and carefree maritime mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic lifestyle editorial collection with close-up, medium and wide framings, natural textures, realistic ocean and boat materials, varied eye-level and 45-degree angles.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Four-scene photorealistic yacht lifestyle collection featuring a clearly adult original red-haired woman: close-up playful selfie inside a wood-paneled yacht in an oversized cream linen shirt over a tan lace-inspired camisole; laughing beside a sailboat mast in a black silk slip dress; seated on deck in a navy-and-white striped tee and white cotton shorts; and perched on the bow in a classy black mini dress, with ocean, coastline, rigging, calm water and golden-hour light across the scenes.
